children.source: sb => { visits += 1; if stop { return sb.write_string("[stop]") }; sb.write_string("[keep]"); visits += 10 }
sb => { for n in 0..<4 { if n == limit { return }; visited += 1; sb.write(n) }; sb.write_string("done") }
sb => { for n in 0..<6 { if n == 1 { continue }; if n == 4 { break }; sb.write(n) }; sb.write_string("done") }
sb => { guard value is Some(n) else { return sb.write_string("none") }; match n { 0 => return sb.write_string("zero"); _ => sb.write(n) }; sb.write_string("done") }
sb => { let inner = "inner<\{sb => { sb.write_string("x"); return }}>"; sb.write_string(inner); sb.write_string("/continued") }
sb => { let render = n => { if n == 0 { return }; sb.write(n) }; render(0); render(3); sb.write_string("done") }
sb => { defer sb.write_string("D1"); defer sb.write_string("D2"); sb.write_string("B"); if stop { return }; sb.write_string("E") }
sb => { try { sb.write(render_or_raise(n)) } catch { RenderError(code) => { sb.write_string("error"); sb.write(code); return } }; sb.write_string("done") }
